note: Signing identity per module. The digest here is the ONLY accepted signer for that package: a build whose cert differs is rejected, because a different cert means the phone must uninstall before it can update. Modules keep the key they were first published with; new modules use the shared 'fixed' key. Private keys never live in this repo.
